title: primulina poilanei
intro: Primulina poilanei, commonly known as the "Poilane's primulina", is a type of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. It is native to Vietnam and is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues. The plant has been found to have potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Primulina poilanei include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
